men.summary: Two games into the 2026-27 season, the Bluejays are 2-0 at home with double-digit wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), though their early NET of 83 and RPI of 119 reflect how little data exists and how light the opposition has been. With Big East play yet to begin and no Quadrant 1 games played, their postseason outlook is wide open, and building an at-large résumé will depend on climbing the NET through conference games and quality non-conference opportunities.

women.summary: The Bluejays are 2-0 after road wins at South Dakota State (73-71) and North Dakota State (66-60), and the first of those counts as a Quadrant 1 victory. Their RPI of 21 looks strong but their NET of 91 is far less convincing, so with Big East play still at 0-0, any postseason case will depend on adding quality conference wins to improve that résumé.
